question: In similar triangles, the ratio of corresponding altitudes is 2:5. What is the ratio of their areas?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For similar triangles, the ratio of their areas equals the square of the ratio of their corresponding altitudes.

Ratio of areas = (Ratio of altitudes)²

⇒ Area Ratio = (2 ÷ 5)² = 4 : 25

**∴ The correct answer is 4:25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of corresponding altitudes of two similar triangles (h₁ : h₂) = 2 : 5

**Formula Used:**

Area of Δ₁ ÷ Area of Δ₂ = (h₁ ÷ h₂)²

 

 
• 
 

 h1 = 2
 Area = A1
 
 

 
• 
 

 h2 = 5
 Area = A2

 A1 : A2 = h1² : h2²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of Δ₁ ÷ Area of Δ₂ = (2 ÷ 5)²

⇒ Area of Δ₁ ÷ Area of Δ₂ = 4 ÷ 25

⇒ Ratio of their areas = 4 : 25

**∴ The correct answer is 4:25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Similar Triangles

The ratio of the areas of two similar triangles is precisely equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides, altitudes, or medians.

Perimeter of Similar Triangles

The ratio of the perimeters of two similar triangles is directly equal to the ratio of their corresponding sides, altitudes, or medians.

Inradius & Circumradius Ratio

For two similar triangles, the ratio of their corresponding inradii or circumradii follows the exact same ratio as their corresponding sides.
